d:
Sudan yuddh men ab tak hazaron log mare ja chuke hain, aur lakhon log beghar ho gae hain. duniya ke sabse bare manviy sankat par itni kam charcha kyon ho rahi hai?
Aprail 2023 se sudan men laraee chhiri huee hai. tab ardhasainik bal ‘raipid saport phorsez’ ne sudan ki sena se laraee shuru ki thi. satta ki is laraee ki qimat aam logon ne chukaee hai. darphur men halat khaskar behad kharab hain, jahan visheshagy aur sanyukt rashtr lanbe samay se narsanhar ke sanketon ko lekar chetavni dete rahe hain.
